topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: Well, I ain't never left my plot of earth, but I reckon some things should stay buried like seeds in the soil. Found that piece of parchment with all them grand dreams scribbled on it. Thoughts of faraway lands and deeds none of us here would dare dream of. I should have kept it to myself, but I told her. Watched her face light up, then cloud over. Now, she's off at the edge of our village, staring at the horizon. I know the look, the longing. The fields feel too tight, the sky too low. I can feel the weight of it, her silence. Maybe I should have let the paper stay lost. But it's done now, and the harvests to come will tell the tale.
